section.translationText: Clears the translation cache and performs a warm-up. This is executed asynchronously via a message.

nlx-translation-provider-notice.title: Translations are managed externally
nlx-translation-provider-notice.text: The Translation Bridge plugin is active: storefront translations are now loaded from the translation provider "{provider}" and no longer from the snippets maintained here. Changes made in this view may be overridden by the provider.
